identity.role: Former lawyer for Luchy Playa Blanca / Concurso 36/2012

documented_role_window.limitation: The precise original engagement instrument/start day remains to be recovered.

transform.purpose: Remove the standing woman at left and retain the seated subject, audience and projection context.
transform.enhancement: Deterministic contrast/sharpening only; no subject replacement, synthesis or scene alteration.

portrait.publication_boundary: The project attributes the depicted seated man to Juan Tomás Parrilla based on the user's supplied identification; the repository does not claim independent biometric identification.

chronology.proposition: Contemporaneous correspondence records Parrilla preparing/coordinating a reposición concerning the sale of locales/pool and the unitary productive-unit issue.
chronology.boundary: This is counterevidence to any blanket claim of total non-action.

chronology.proposition: A draft pleading sought judicial intervention, Fiscalía referral and reservation of separation/responsibility actions concerning the Administrador Concursal.
chronology.boundary: A Drive custody copy is labelled NO PRESENTADA and later project-side correspondence says it was not filed; certified court/LexNET proof remains required.

chronology.proposition: Parrilla directly stated he wanted the deed before advancing a substantive nullity/fraud challenge, opposed a broader filing at that stage and proposed a narrower request for court-ordered production of the deed; Rosa Gual agreed with that scope.
chronology.boundary: Motive beyond the stated rationale is not inferred; whether the narrower protective request was filed/performed remains open.

chronology.proposition: The client communicated substitution of Parrilla as letrado director, expressly framing the immediate reason as mutual loss of confidence and thanking him for the preceding eight years of work.
chronology.boundary: This is the formal immediate transition cause on the current record.

chronology.proposition: Parrilla accepted the venia, briefed successor counsel and said his fee liquidation had to be communicated to the Administrador Concursal.
chronology.boundary: This establishes the asserted fee route, not that any payment was improper.

chronology.proposition: Incoming counsel Daniel Jiménez contemporaneously reported that the AC said Parrilla's and the procuradora's invoices would be paid from concurso funds and praised Parrilla's work.
chronology.boundary: This is Daniel's contemporaneous report, not a direct AC recording or independent finding.

chronology.proposition: Jiménez contemporaneously said his team had broken off negotiations with Parrilla and the AC because he perceived an attempt to condition the successor team's work on fee payment, and that he did not want his fees to depend on the AC's view.
chronology.boundary: Perceived conditioning is evidence for investigation; it is not proof of bribery, unlawful payment or corrupt purpose.

chronology.proposition: A controlled AC liquidation-operations report expressly lists 'Juan Tomás Parrilla 26750 jul-20 Honorarios abogado concursada'; the same entry is repeated in a later AC report.
chronology.boundary: This proves the AC reported the amount/month/concept. It is not the matching bank debit, invoice, payment authority or proof of impropriety; complete bank and accounting tracing remains required.

central_question: Why was the broader 4-Jan-2019 protective draft not filed, what narrower protective action was actually taken, and what—if any—causal relationship existed between later AC-controlled fee/payment discussions and the deterioration/end of Parrilla's representation?
investigative_tests: Recover certified court/LexNET filing history for the 4-Jan-2019 draft and the 9-Jan proposed deed-production request.
Establish the date and route by which the sale deed became available to project counsel.
Recover the complete Parrilla retainer, fee agreements, proformas, invoices, payments, refunds/credits and IGIC treatment.
Recover the estate payment authority, ledger entry and matching bank debit for the later €26,750 payment.
Recover direct AC-Parrilla communications concerning fees, settlement, incoming counsel and any complaint/withdrawal discussions.
Test lawful insolvency-fee administration and professional-judgment explanations against the project-side interference hypothesis.
Keep the Concurso Judge outside the causal chain unless and until judge-specific acts and evidence independently support a proposition.
Reconcile the AC-reported 26750 jul-20 entry against the original invoice, IGIC/cost allocation, payment authority, estate ledger and matching bank debit.
Recover the primary fourth AC report and the matching CAM sale-consideration / estate-account bank movements to test the upstream payment chain.
non_transfer_rules: Non-filing does not prove corrupt motive.
Payment does not prove bribery or criminal knowledge.
Successor counsel's perception of conditioning is attributed evidence, not an adjudicated fact.
A lawyer's act, knowledge or motive does not transfer to the Administrador Concursal, Acosta Matos perimeter, the Concurso Judge or another professional without actor-specific evidence.
The client's later allegation is not substituted for contemporaneous professional evidence.
source_classes: 4-Jan-2019 draft pleading and controlled Drive custody copies
Existing AC fee/accounting and legal-representation Truth Machine controls
private_source_policy: Provider message IDs, private addresses and privileged/native materials remain in controlled private custody and are not reproduced in this public-safe control.

upstream_transaction_context.proposition: A contemporaneous Cuatrecasas email summarising the court notice and the AC's fourth report states that the AC reported selling the common-area properties to CAM in order to begin paying credits against the estate, 'por el momento, sus honorarios'.
upstream_transaction_context.boundary: The primary fourth AC report and bank movements remain priority sources. This does not prove a direct personal CAM-to-AC payment, quid pro quo, bribery or corrupt inducement.
upstream_transaction_context.visual_rule: Until a bank-complete chain proves otherwise, depict the upstream flow as CAM -> LPB estate / sale consideration -> estate claims / AC fees, not CAM -> AC personally.

visualization_rules: Do not label the CAM-to-estate transaction as a bribe or direct personal payment to the AC absent bank/source proof.
For Parrilla, label the flow as an AC-reported estate payment entry of 26750 in jul-20 for debtor-company legal fees; matching bank debit, invoice and authority remain open.
The non-filing question must be shown together with Parrilla's contemporaneous stated procedural/evidentiary rationale and proposed narrower production request.
Any question about causation of the end of representation remains a question for investigation, not a declared motive or finding.
